div.head: Af 26
div.ab: XXVII. Gif mon ungewintredne wifmon to nydhæmede geðreatige, sy ðæt swa ðæs gewintredon monnes bot.
XXVII. Gif mon ungewintrædne wifmon to niedhæmde geðreatige, sie ðæt swa ðæs gewintredan monnes bot.
Si quis uirginem immaturam ad uiolentum concubitum perferendum cogat, sit hoc sicut adulte mulieris emendatio.
{XXVII} Gif mon ungewintrædne wifmon to niedhæmde geðreatige, sie ðæt swa ðæs gewintredan monnes bot.
If someone rapes an underage girl, let the compensation be the same as for a mature person.
If anyone rapes a girl who is not of age, the same compensation shall be paid for her as to an adult.
If anyone rapes a girl not of age, that is to be the same compensation as for an adult.
Wenn jemand ein unerwachsenes Mädchen zu Nothzucht drängt, sei das [so hoch zu büssen] wie die Busse für die erwachsene Person.
If someone forces an under-age girl to intercourse, let that be [compensated as highly] as the compensation for an adult person.
